title: TruckStateChangelogEvent
description: Value schema for messages on truck-state-changelog. Kafka-side contract only — the RocksDB team owns the 'state' object's exact shape and may extend it; this defines the minimum expected structure. Message key is truck_id (string), same as truck-telemetry, so per-truck state stays co-located on one partition.

window.description: The 5-minute window this state snapshot belongs to.

state.description: Owned by the RocksDB / Stream Processing team. Minimum expected fields shown below for a rolling-average use case.
